markdown:
# Space

You might say
Everything feels piled together. Adjust the spacing so related things stay close and separate things have room.

**Use empty space to show which things belong together**·Related items should sit close together, while separate groups need more room between them. That empty room is spacing. A product usually defines a small spacing scale so pages follow a visible rhythm instead of using a new value each time.

## You can say this to an AI Agent

> “
> Adjust the profile form spacing so labels stay close to their fields and separate field groups use a larger reusable gap. Do not position content with spaces or blank lines. Verify grouping with long labels and at mobile width.

### When to use it

- Keep a label close to the field it describes

NameAlex Chen

- Separate one content group from the next
- Give text and controls enough room to breathe

CancelSave
- Build a reusable spacing scale for the whole product

- Use empty space to hide a weak information structure
